calculation.description: For each tradable asset, estimate a 60-session rolling beta to the equal-weight cross-asset return using lagged observations, form beta-neutral residual returns, combine 20- and 60-session residual trends, volatility-normalize, smooth over three sessions, and reverse the cross-sectional rank. All signal inputs are lagged one completed session. Negative original trend is therefore rewarded.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history absolute IC and ICIR pass benchmark gates (0.0070 and 0.0840). Negative raw trend IC is intentionally represented as a positive reversal factor. Recent 365-day and 1260-day ICIR remain strong; 750-day window is weak, so monitor drift conservatively.
